question: How should one protect the vulnerable being in this ritual context?
premises: A mother protects a child born from a lover.
That child is treated as her own son.
This protection is given as the model.
inference: One should protect the designated being with the same care as a mother protects her own child.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the one to be protected is implied by context.
plain_english: Just as a mother protects as her own son a child born from a lover, so one should protect.
